instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a wide full-body shot captures an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpeted floor, white walls, and technical equipment in the background. On the left, the man in the black cap, black polo, and blue shorts (R1) stands in profile facing right, extending his right arm forward. On the right, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands still in profile facing left. The man (R1) touches the cheek of the woman (R2) with his right hand as they stand close together. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead lighting, casting soft shadows on the warm red carpet and neutral background.
